name: Monitor CPO Dispatch
implementation_notes: Mirrors MonitorKernelDispatchView.vue's structural pattern (breadcrumb + hamburger header, draft/pause list, New Data/Load Data/Back footer) but with EVENT-LOG summary semantics: 'Hari Ini' shows Jumlah CPO Dispatch + Jumlah Kejadian Tercatat (not a tipping-progress metric), plus a 'Kejadian Terakhir' card (getLastEventSummary()) showing the single most-recently-logged event across ALL of the user's records (not scoped to today), displaying destination/buyer + event date + tanker plate no instead of Kernel Dispatch's destination/buyer/date/vehicle-plate-no triple (tankerPlateNo is the CPO Dispatch analog of vehiclePlateNo)

localSchema.ts gained 2 new tables (cpo_dispatch_record, cpo_dispatch_detail) via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS — no column-migration function needed since these are brand-new tables, not an existing-table schema change
router/index.ts gained 3 new routes: monitor-cpo-dispatch, cpo-dispatch-form, data-preview-cpo-dispatch

StationListView.vue's draftStatusByType wiring updated: 'cpo-dispatch' now calls cpoDispatchRecordRepo.getDrafts(userId).length > 0 instead of the previous hardcoded false placeholder — MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES already had 'monitor-cpo-dispatch' mapped from an earlier station-list update, so the tile itself needed no further changes. Test file updated with a matching mock (getCpoDispatchDraftsMock) plus a default mockResolvedValue([]) added alongside every existing kernelDispatch default, following the exact convention used for Kernel Dispatch/Process Water/Solid Waste Disposal

cpoDispatchRecordRepo.ts is a new, from-scratch repo file (no pre-existing block to extend) — createDraft()/getTodaySummary()/getLastEventSummary()/getDrafts()/getAllRecords()/getDraftWithDetails()/saveDraft()/pauseDraftWithFormData()/deleteDraft() all written together, with 21 detail columns per entity-catalog cpo-dispatch-detail. Unlike Kernel Dispatch, there is no remarks_gate_status/weighbridge_ticket_no column — CPO Dispatch instead has time_in/time_out (two separate time columns, distinct from event_date) and dobi

known_issues.description: Browser/E2E test not generated for this pass (no Playwright infra wired into this sandbox run) — component-level (Vitest) coverage exercises the same navigation/business logic instead.
Unit test coverage % not measured — no Xdebug/PCOV in this environment, consistent with prior stations in this codebase.
